name: super-ux
description: Full-cycle UX for AI agents: design the chain (foundation -> flows -> screens -> scenarios) before any UI code, keep it in sync on every change, and verify the code against it with evidence-backed audits.

plugins.name: super-ux
plugins.description: Scenario-driven UI development: a versioned design chain in docs/ux/ — product vision -> personas, JTBD, journeys and stories -> user flows -> a screens+states UI map with Figma frames -> traced use-case scenarios -> evidence-backed audits -> concrete fix plans. Skills: vision, ux-foundation, ux-flows, ux-scenarios, ux-audit, brand-voice, copywriting. /ux is the single plain-language entry point and reaches every skill; a stdlib linter fails on doc drift; a tag-indexed best-practices catalog, PRN heuristics and component guidelines guide design; one style pack (via the sheleg-design companion) locks the visual identity.
